app.name: ShifuBot
app.tagline: A calm, friendly helper for your Discord community.

memberPages.signInBody: Sign in with Discord to see this server's lists. Only members of the server can see them.
memberPages.notMemberBody: You are signed in, but not as a member of this server. Only its members can see these lists.
memberPages.notFoundBody: This list does not exist, or it is turned off on this server.

common.leaveBody: Your changes on this page will be lost.

channelPicker.label: Channel
channelPicker.help: Only text channels where ShifuBot can write are listed.
channelPicker.noChannels: ShifuBot cannot write in any text channel. Give it the Send Messages and Embed Links permissions.

rolePicker.label: Role
rolePicker.help: Only roles below ShifuBot's highest role can be given. Drag ShifuBot's role higher in Server Settings → Roles to unlock more.
rolePicker.noRoles: This server has no roles yet. Create one in Server Settings → Roles.

login.title: Welcome to ShifuBot
login.subtitle: Sign in with Discord to configure the bot for the servers you manage.
login.note: We only read your username and the list of servers you manage. We never see your password.

guilds.title: Your servers
guilds.subtitle: Servers where you have the Manage Server permission.
guilds.notAllowedHelp: This ShifuBot can only be added to the servers its owner has allowed.
guilds.empty: You do not manage any servers yet. Create one in Discord or ask for the Manage Server permission.

overview.title: Server overview
overview.languageHelp: Used for the dashboard and every message the bot sends in this server.

permissions.title: Bot permissions
permissions.ok: ShifuBot has every permission its active features need.
permissions.problemBody: Some features will not work until this is fixed.
permissions.grantHelp: Opens Discord with this server selected. Click Authorize and ShifuBot's role gets the missing permissions. Then come back here.
permissions.channelFix: Channel overrides cannot be fixed with the button. In Discord open the channel's settings → Permissions → ShifuBot and allow the permissions listed above.

setup.introBody: ShifuBot is ready to help in {server}. Answer a few quick questions. You can change everything later under Settings.
setup.doneBody: Check your choices below. You can change them any time under Settings.

language.title: Server language
language.description: ShifuBot uses it for this dashboard and for every message it sends in this server.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Everything you chose during setup. Changes apply to the bot instantly.
settings.rerunHelp: Walk through the setup wizard again, starting from your current settings.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or moved.
errors.serverBody: The error was logged. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You need the Manage Server permission in this server.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Slow down a little and try again.
errors.csrf: Security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.bot_not_in_guild: ShifuBot is not in this server yet.
errors.bot_offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now.
errors.oauth_failed: Discord sign in failed. Please try again.
